run_check_inference_types: run the inference types generator to check and update generated type files with --update flag
build_create_init_py: build the __init__.py file with all dataclasses imported from each module
build_generate_reference_package: build the reference package markdown documentation for inference types in English or Korean
review_fix_inference_classes: review the inference class fixing pipeline that inherits from base, renames shared classes, and sets optional defaults
refactor_fix_legacy_annotation: refactor legacy type annotations by replacing List and Dict with lowercase list and dict
